description: Skelet P14: headless OpenPencil adapter grain with confined file-mode CLI, pack-to-pen helper, and fixture tests (no genuine binary yet)

compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: only editor-adapters package plus one CI test-list line; vector/raster adapters untouched; no schema, API, MCP, migration, donor import, or config change; existing routes/tests unaffected? Any changed behavior?

correctness.instructions: Is the adapter factually correct against the pinned OpenPencil 78355fd contract: file-mode commands tree/node/query/info/export/convert with --json and allowlisted argv; app-mode refused; .fig/.pen inputs only; convert output .fig only; export allowlist fig/svg/png/jpg/webp with pdf/pptx/html/jsx refused; pen helper authors valid JSON with frame/rectangle children; SVG validate/inspect matches vector semantics?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 19 fixture tests pass plus 1 genuine-binary skip; vector 24/24 and raster 26/26 still green; lint/typecheck clean; graft build/check green; CI wiring adds the new suite; no genuine-binary claim (fixture boundary documented)? Any test claim without a run?

reliability.instructions: Any reliability risk: absolute-path-only binary with pin equality; root confinement with realpath and symlink refusal; scrubbed env; timeout/SIGKILL/cancel; output/input budgets; deterministic error codes; TOCTOU caveat documented like AF-10/11?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the P14 headless adapter grain: pack-to-document journey beyond the pure pen helper plus fixture convert/export; .fig round-trip fidelity proof; PageDraw transplant; UI; billing; or unrelated refactors? Are documents/import/diff/eval/tool and desktops correctly refused rather than deferred silently?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: no shell; no PATH hijack; no app-bridge token use; no network; no secrets in env; traversal/symlink/device-name refusal; unsafe SVG refusal; anonymous requestor refused; pack provenance required with workspace match; budgets enforced?
